data.one_liner: A single line text widget with customizable ellipsis placement (start, middle, or end).
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display text in a single line with adjustable ellipsis positions such as start, middle, or end. Useful for shortening crypto wallet addresses or other abbreviated information.
use_when: You need a single-line text widget with a middle or start ellipsis.
You are displaying shortened crypto wallet addresses.
avoid_when: You need advanced auto-sizing text capabilities.
strengths: Simple API with preset types for start, middle, and end ellipsis positions.
Supports standard text styling properties like textScaleFactor/textScaler, strutStyle, and locale.
weaknesses: Limited to one line of text.
Not documented for complex multi-line truncations.

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need text to automatically resize to fit available space instead of strictly positioning an ellipsis.

data.minimal_example:
EllipsizedText(
    "Ellipsized Text Ellipsized Text Ellipsized Text Ellipsized Text",
    type: EllipsisType.middle,
    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24),
)
